title: Stock and b-roll
description: Sourcing footage and stills that read as real rather than stock: what makes stock look like stock and the treatments that fix it, the sourcing order from the user's own material through connectors to generated, and how to prompt a video or image model for UGC-grade material (handheld, available light, imperfect framing, a real room). Load it when an ad needs cut-aways, a product shot or a staged still nobody has photographed.
summary: Cut-aways that read as real: the sourcing order, the four treatments that fix stock, and how to prompt for UGC-grade footage.

requires.why: Stock stills and short clips for environments and textures.
Video generation for the staged shots stock never has.
A second route to video and music generation.
The user's own material, and real brand imagery, into assets/.
Whether a shot reads as real is a judgement made by looking.

models.note: Prompt against its cinematic instinct: handheld, available light, imperfect framing.
Alternate route when fal is not connected.
Phone photo, available light, a cluttered real room.

triggers: find me some b-roll for this ad
generate a shot of someone struggling with this
what should I cut away to
make the generated footage look more real
